title: Drain Atom
description: Schema for a single drain item in the DRAIN system. Each item is a work unit with typed status, mode, evidence, and invariant enforcement.

id.description: Unique drain item identifier. Format: drain-{slug}-{epoch_ms}

label.description: Human-readable label for the drain item.

mode.description: Operational mode governing what happens to this item.

status.description: Execution truth state. REAL = verified complete. PARTIAL = in progress or unverified. BLOCKED = validator rule violation. ARCHIVED = closed and immutable.

importance.description: Priority classification. IP and STRATEGIC require evidence before ARCHIVE.

evidence.description: Typed evidence string. Required for REAL status and for IP/STRATEGIC importance. Format: {type}:{ref} e.g. commit:abc123, receipt:zdgnab3py0, issue:74

bridge_id.description: Required for HANDOFF mode. Bridge session identifier.

receipt_ref.description: Receipt reference returned by bridge after successful HANDOFF. Required to promote HANDOFF from PARTIAL to REAL.

target_ref.description: Required for REGISTER mode. Target entity reference (repo, issue, file path, etc).

notes.description: Optional freeform notes. Not used in validation.

closed_at.description: ISO8601 close timestamp. Set when status transitions to ARCHIVED.

allOf.description: V1: ARCHIVE requires status=REAL and evidence.
V2: KILL blocked on IP/STRATEGIC importance items.
